messages:
luna: quick UX review re: timeline row density + rollback affordance. trying a compact row with icon-only actions to reduce vertical noise. reactions?

chris: icon-only reduces clutter but hurts discoverability. can we add a visible label on hover/focus and large hit targets? current icons are ~12px which is too small for touch.

devon: agree. minimum 24px tap area. also keyboard users should see the label on focus, not just hover. aria-expanded for collapse groups needs to be announced.

rachel: microcopy thought: current rollback tooltip "Rollback" is ambiguous. suggest 'Rollback to this version' for title and keep button label short. ensure SR gets the full sentence via aria-describedby.

a11y-bot: checklist: 24px hit targets, focus-visible styles for icon buttons, aria-expanded on collapsible groups, aria-live polite for promotion updates, descriptive aria-describedby for Rollback. avoid moving DOM order for visual effects; use CSS order if needed.
